steps.content: The suspicion hardens into a cold knot. Did the phantom thieves create this themselves?
It's the only explanation. No one else could replicate those moments so perfectly.
You remove the simulation device and turn to ask Wynn, who is standing beside you.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Well... it was brought in by this lady wearing a suit. Oh, and I think there were two people walking right behind her?

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Hmm, that's so weird... How come... I can't picture their faces at all?
Before she finishes speaking, you notice the simulation device you just turned off has gone completely dark.
You fumble to restart it. Nothing. You try charging it, pressing every button, but the screen remains a dead, blank slate.
